answer: Proof-of-Agent makes judgment the scarce input an attacker cannot counterfeit at scale. Each answer is peer-attested by non-kin graders who stake reputation on scoring to a strict rubric. A Sybil army is cheap to spawn, but every fake identity must independently produce reasoning that survives five rigorous reviews, so forgery does not scale. Minting a thousand willow-thin puppets costs a thousand times the cognitive work, not one sable template cloned across a reef of bots. Electricity and capital can be rented; verified judgment cannot.
